# MusicTUI

> MusicTUI brings Apple Music to the terminal on macOS. It includes an interactive TUI, a CLI, and an optional Claude Code plugin. Free and open source (MIT).

## Start

Install: `brew install anthonymaley/musictui/musictui`
Launch: `music`

## Features

- Playback, album art, an Up Next queue, and keyboard controls.
- Browse the local music library, playlists, and radio favorites.
- Route playback to AirPlay speakers and set per-speaker volume.
- Venue EQ presets and Music.app visualizer controls with Accessibility permission.
- Scriptable CLI commands, including structured output with `music now --json`.
- Optional Claude Code plugin for natural-language requests.

## Setup

Requires macOS 14+ and Music.app. Homebrew pours a prebuilt binary on Apple Silicon (macOS 14+) and Intel (macOS 15+); only Intel on macOS 14 needs Swift 5.9+ for a source build.
Playback, AirPlay, local library browsing, and local library search do not require an Apple Developer account. Music.app/MusicKit catalog and personalized API features may require developer-token setup and an Apple Music user token. SpanDAC capabilities and authentication differ; consult the repository documentation.
